title: Sewing Machine Run-Hours Maintenance Window
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shelly:status machine_name=* run_minutes=*
| stats sum(run_minutes) as total_run_minutes by machine_name
| eval run_hours=round(total_run_minutes/60,1)
| where run_hours>25
| sort - run_hours
description: Uses smart-plug runtime to identify when a sewing machine is due for cleaning, oiling, or a quick inspection.
value: Maintenance windows tied to real run-hours are easier to trust than vague memory about the last busy month.
implementation: Attach a Shelly plug to the machine, roll up `run_minutes`, and choose a runtime threshold that fits the model.
visualization: Table of sewing machines by accumulated run hours.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks when the sewing machine has worked enough hours that it deserves some care.
